blocks.text: Discover the reliable Logitech M196 Bluetooth Wireless Mouse and declutter your workspace. This convenient portable mouse pairs to your laptop or tablet in seconds via Bluetooth—no dongle or port required. Enjoy a 12-month battery life (1) and auto sleep feature to help you go longer between AA battery changes. Small enough to toss in a bag, this comfortable Bluetooth travel mouse has an ambidextrous design that guides either your right or left hand into a natural position. The Logitech M196 Wireless Bluetooth Mouse is made to last with recycled plastic. (1) Battery life varies with use conditions. (2) Excludes plastic in printed wiring assembly (PWA) and packaging.

items.label: Convenient Portable Mouse for Laptops and Tablets
items.value: The Logitech M196 Bluetooth Wireless Mouse connects in seconds with a reliable pair-and-play Bluetooth connection—no dongle or port required

items.label: Comfortable, Travel-Ready Design
items.value: This Bluetooth travel mouse is lightweight and fits in any bag; its contoured, ambidextrous shape is comfortable for both left and right hands

items.label: Works on a Variety of Surfaces
items.value: With precise line-by-line scrolling and optical tracking; the M196 Wireless Bluetooth Mouse provides smooth and accurate cursor control on nearly any surface

items.label: Made to Last With Recycled Plastic
items.value: The plastic parts in the M196 contain certified post-consumer recycled plastic (67% for Graphite and 66% for Off-White and Rose (2))

items.label: 12-Month Battery Life
items.value: Enjoy a reliable 12-month battery life (1) and auto sleep feature for longer use between battery changes; 1 AA battery included

items.label: A Small Wireless Mouse for Almost Any Device
items.value: This versatile and cost-effective Bluetooth mouse is ideal for productivity and learning on the move; works with most operating systems and devices

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: Gaming Console, Personal Computer, Smartphone, Tablet

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: 1 AA battery (pre-installed), M196 Mouse, User documentation
